description: A short team check-in: progress, plans, blockers.
context: A daily standup. Every bullet lead is the person's name: their known name, else the speaker label verbatim. Keep each person's update to what they themselves said and never merge two people's updates into one bullet.

sections.heading: Progress Since Last Standup
sections.instructions: One bullet per person, led by their name, with what they finished or moved forward since the last standup.

sections.heading: Plans Until Next Standup
sections.instructions: One bullet per person, led by their name, with what they will work on until the next standup.

sections.heading: Blockers and Help Needed
sections.instructions: Blockers, dependencies and requests for help, led by the person's name, with what or whom they are waiting on. Omit the section when there are none.

sections.heading: Announcements
sections.instructions: Team-wide announcements, decisions and schedule changes that are not one person's update.
